verdict.rationale: Browserbase's own marketing says its fetch capability converts any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown, so receiving scraped content as JSON is a first-party feature. The only evidence is that one homepage line, with nothing on schemas, structured extraction or response format. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the JSON output structure, schema-driven structured extraction, API reference examples of JSON responses, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive scraped content as structured JSON

citations.quote: Quickly fetch web context for your agent by converting any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown
